font.$description: Typefaces, from the brand book (2026-10-23, page 18). Both cover Romanian (ș ț with the comma below) and Cyrillic, both are under the SIL Open Font License, and both are self-hosted from assets/fonts/.

serif.$description: Logo, headings and large figures. SemiBold 600, always the 24pt optical size

sans.$description: Body text, labels, tables, buttons and the app. 400, 500, 600. Decided by the owner on 2026-10-24; DESIGN.md's Onest does not apply

type.$description: The web type scale, from the brand book's hierarchy table (page 19). Where the brand book gives a range, min and max are its two ends; how a size moves between them is not decided. The app's denser sizes are not decided either.

weight.$description: Display, h1 and h2 are Literata SemiBold

optical-size.$description: font-variation-settings 'opsz'. The display cuts thin the K's arm to a hairline

figures.$description: font-variant-numeric for every amount, so digits line up in columns
